Bulgarian

[edit]
Bulgarian Wikipedia has an article on:
история
Wikipedia bg

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed through German Historie or Russian исто́рия (istórija), in turn from Latin historia, from Ancient Greek ἱστορία (historía).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [iˈstɔrijɐ]
  • Audio (Standard Bulgarian):(file)
  • Rhymes: -ɔrijɐ
  • Syllabification(key): и‧сто‧ри‧я
  • Hyphenation(key): ис‧то‧рия

Noun

[edit]

исто́рия • (istórija) f (relational adjective истори́чески, diminutive исто́рийка)

  1. (uncountable) history (science of the past; past events; course of development)
    Наро́д, ко́йто е впи́сал в исто́рията побе́ди...
    Naród, kójto e vpísal v istórijata pobédi...
    A nation that has inscribed victories in history...
    То́зи град ня́ма исто́рия.
    Tózi grad njáma istórija.
    This city has no history.
    Те са вече исто́рия.
    Te sa veče istórija.
    They are already history (things of the past).
  2. (in the singular) history (school subject)
    час по исто́рия
    čas po istórija
    history class
  3. (colloquial) history textbook
    Ку́пих си но́ва исто́рия.
    Kúpih si nóva istórija.
    I bought myself a new history book.
  4. story, tale, yarn, affair, incident
    Synonyms: приключе́ние (priključénie), ра́зказ (rázkaz), слу́чка (slúčka)
    ловджи́йски исто́рии
    lovdžíjski istórii
    hunting stories
    же́нска исто́рия
    žénska istórija
    a woman affair

Pannonian Rusyn

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Serbo-Croatian историја / istorija or earlier Carpathian Rusyn істо́рія (istórija), ultimately from Ancient Greek ἱστορία (historía). Displaced Old Slovak história.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [istɔˈrija]
  • Rhymes: -ija
  • Hyphenation: ис‧то‧рия

Noun

[edit]

история (istorija) f (relational adjective историйни)

  1. history
  2. story, tale

Declension

[edit]

nominative история (istorija) историї (istoriji)
genitive историї (istoriji) историйох (istorijox)
dative историї (istoriji) историйом (istorijom)
accusative историю (istoriju) историї (istoriji)
instrumental историю (istoriju) историями (istorijami)
locative историї (istoriji) историйох (istorijox)
vocative историйо (istorijo) историї (istoriji)

[edit]
nouns
  • историчар m pers (istoričar)
  • историят m inan (istorijat)
  • предистория f (predistorija)

  • Fejsa, M.; Šlemender, M.; Čelʹovski, S. (2022), “history”, in Анґлийско-руски словнїк [English-Rusyn Dictionary] (in Pannonian Rusyn), Novi Sad: Faculty of Philosophy; Ruska matka, →ISBN, page 138

Russian

[edit]

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • исто́рія (istórija) — pre-1918 spelling

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from French histoire, remodelled with an awareness of Latin historia or Ancient Greek ἱστορία (historía), from Ancient Greek ἵστωρ (hístōr), from Proto-Indo-European *wéydtōr, from Proto-Indo-European *weyd-.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [ɪˈstorʲɪjə]
  • Audio:(file)

Noun

[edit]

исто́рия • (istórija) f inan (genitive исто́рии, nominative plural исто́рии, genitive plural исто́рий)

  1. history
  2. story
  3. affair, thing

[edit]

  • истори́ческий (istoríčeskij)
  • истори́чный (istoríčnyj)
  • предысто́рия f (predystórija)

Related terms

[edit]
Borrowed

Close related, analyzable as derived:

  • истори́зм m (istorízm)
  • историо́граф m anim (istoriógraf)
  • историогра́фия f (istoriográfija)
Native

Related via Proto-Indo-European *weyd-:

  • ве́дать impf (védatʹ), ви́деть impf (vídetʹ)
  • ве́домость f (védomostʹ)
  • весть f (vestʹ), изве́стие n (izvéstije)
  • све́дение n (svédenije)
  • свиде́тель m anim (svidételʹ), свиде́тельство n (svidételʹstvo)

Descendants

[edit]
  • → Ingrian: istoria
  • → Komi-Zyrian: история (istorija)
  • → Yakut: остуоруйа (ostuoruya)

See also

[edit]
  • исротия (isrotija) (online slang, derogatory)
